title: Bombing Voronezh
author: Pr1nted
$comment: Driving rather than ceremonial: lead and rhythm guitar, electric bass and a full kit under the sax carrying the seed theme. Sits at high energy with tension just above Parade Uniform's, which puts it in the same neighbourhood as the theme during a war -- close enough that the repeat penalty trades the two off, so a long war alternates between the orchestral reading and this one instead of looping either. Loses the menu to Parade Uniform on energy. Editable source: data/audio/midi/Bombing Voronezh.mid
